title: Corroborative Learning: Mutual Enhancement through Task-Response Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.41222v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In pattern analysis, models trained independently for the same task often develop complementary capabilities through differences in architecture, data, and optimization. Exploiting complementarity while retaining independent deployment is central to collaborative learning. Most methods establish transfer by reducing differences in predictions, relations, or representations between target and collaborator, although these differences also underlie complementarity. This creates a structural trade-off between reducing differences for knowledge exchange and preserving them for complementarity. We therefore propose Corroborative Learning (CL). Each model forms task-driven responses, with cross-group support from its collaborator. Source-excluded reconstruction of response increments from collaborator representations separates fitting and evaluation across disjoint groups and selectively constrains directions by cross-group reconstructability.

translated_title: 佐证学习：通过任务-响应重构实现相互增强
translated_abstract: 在模式分析中，针对同一任务独立训练的模型往往因架构、数据和优化方式的差异而发展出互补的能力。在保持各模型可独立部署的同时利用这种互补性，是协同学习的核心。大多数方法通过缩小目标模型与协作模型之间在预测、关系或表示上的差异来建立知识迁移，然而这些差异恰恰也是互补性的根源。这在“为知识交换而减小差异”与“为维持互补性而保留差异”之间造成了结构性的权衡。为此，我们提出了佐证学习。每个模型形成任务驱动的响应，并获得来自协作模型的跨组支持。基于协作者表示对响应增量进行源排除式重构，将拟合与评估分离到互不相交的组中，并通过跨组可重构性选择性地约束方向。
tldr: 提出佐证学习框架，通过源排除式的响应增量跨组重构，在保留模型间差异以维持互补性的同时实现相互增强，化解了协同学习中知识交换与互补保持之间的结构性权衡。
en_tdlr: Proposes Corroborative Learning, which achieves mutual enhancement through source-excluded cross-group reconstruction of response increments, preserving inter-model differences for complementarity while enabling knowledge exchange, thereby resolving the structural trade-off in collaborative learning.
